title: NovaDesk Signup
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm install && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite; dist/index.html exists
checks.desktop: passed: Chromium 1440x1000; centered 896x660 card; no layout overflow
checks.mobile: passed: Chromium 390x844; 358px single-column card; no layout overflow
checks.video: passed: exact URL, 1920x1080 decoded video, muted autoplay playing on both viewports
checks.interactions: passed on both viewports: native required email validation, show/hide password, checkbox, valid submit feedback, Google/Apple/Twitter preview feedback, Rules/Privacy Notice/Enter feedback, dismissal

asset_issues: No unavailable assets. The browser request log includes two net::ERR_ABORTED video stream requests; the video successfully decoded and played in both viewports. Full request records are preserved in screenshots/checks.json.
The specified MP4 is loaded from its exact external URL and requires network access at runtime.
notes: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Vite; lucide-react interface icons; supplied custom SVG brand; system fonts.
The written prompt's Sign up heading is used despite the reference image showing Join us.
Authentication, OAuth, legal documents, and existing-account destinations were not supplied; actions show explicit preview-only feedback and do not claim account creation.
Only NovaDesk Signup was implemented. No agents, other sessions, deployment, push, or messages were used.
Ready means ready for review, not deployed.
